qualifications: All variants receive the exact same immutable canonical snapshot and original recorded evaluation/TTL clocks.
Canonical replays of raw native inputs retain source timestamps but declare their logical completion clock; they are not native freshness measurements.
Physical object metadata is evaluation-only. Motion ranking receives only exposure robot points and a recorded public target/corridor when available.
Registry call counts use the unchanged registry with a counting numeric interface. They predict orchestration operations, not installed-SDK registration latency.
Full-capture IO perturbs native cadence; extraction wall times are offline CPU measurements, not control or GPU performance.
Endpoint surface support is not full-solid reconstruction or a certified free-space/swept-path guarantee.

full_report.scope: Ignored full scalar diagnostics and exact numeric source/cell-audit references; no cumulative mask replaces canonical state.

reference.qualification: Actual post-insertion kinematic fixture pose; verified unchanged through recorded motion trace. Pre-motion exposures rely on the static kinematic-body invariant, not a trace timestamp join.

physical_attribution.scope: Evaluation-only primitive or actual cooked-convex face-halfspace first-hit intersections. Cooked-plane queries are floating numeric face representations, not a vertex-hull distance certificate. Counts are current eligible occupied cells also supported by a matching current native depth endpoint; historical-only occupied surfaces and full-solid IoU are unmeasured.
